name: Teaching AI Literacy
definition: Educators' competence to design and deliver age-appropriate AI-literacy instruction for school learners - selecting tools, pedagogies and activities that make AI concepts learnable in primary and secondary classrooms.
definition_de: Kompetenz von Lehrpersonen, altersgerechten KI-Unterricht für Schülerinnen und Schüler zu gestalten und durchzuführen – Werkzeuge, Didaktik und Aktivitäten so zu wählen, dass KI-Konzepte in Primar- und Sekundarklassen lernbar werden.
uncertainty: Early evidence (small in-service-teacher studies) that targeted pedagogical designs raise teachers' readiness to teach AI literacy; durability and transfer across contexts need more study.

name: Educator Digital and AI Competence
definition: Educators' own digital and AI literacy - the foundational technological competence teachers need to use AI tools responsibly and integrate tech-driven pedagogy into school teaching.
definition_de: Die eigene Digital- und KI-Kompetenz von Lehrpersonen – die technologische Grundkompetenz, um KI-Werkzeuge verantwortungsvoll zu nutzen und technologiegestützte Didaktik in den Schulunterricht zu integrieren.
uncertainty: Survey evidence indicates many educators hold only moderate digital literacy; the size and drivers of the gap, and which interventions close it, need more study.
